title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT LUKSOZ ME OBORR TEK SECRET GARDEN !
description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1+2 me oborr tek Secret Garden Residence .
Prona ndodhet ne katin perdhe te nje objekti 3-katesh. Pjese e nje kompleksi qe ofron cilesi te larte jetese, ofron qetesi ajer te paster etj.
Apartamenti ka nje investim luksoz i bere sefundmi dhe me elektroshtepiake te markave me te mira ne treg.

Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni !
title_en: LUXURY APARTMENT FOR SALE WITH COURTYARD AT SECRET GARDEN!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment with a yard at Secret Garden Residence. The property is located on the ground floor of a 3-story building. Part of a complex that offers a high quality of life, offers calm, clean air, etc. The apartment has a luxury investment made recently and with household appliances of the best brands in the market. It has a total area of ​​196m2, of which 178.4m2 is net and 17.6m2 is a common area. It is organized in 1 living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a yard for your use by exiting the living room. Has regular documentation. For more information contact us!
